title: The Carroll A. Deering Mystery
hook: In January 1921 a schooner was found run aground off Cape Hatteras, North Carolina, and nothing adds up.

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In January 1921, the schooner Carroll A. Deering was found abandoned off Cape Hatteras, North Carolina.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The vessel's logbook was missing, and the crew's personal effects were missing as well.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Investigators found the galley fire extinguished and the deck slick with oil.

beats.label: CLUE 3
beats.line: A local fisherman reported seeing lights on the hull the night before the discovery.

beats.label: THEORY
beats.line: One theory suggests the crew abandoned ship to avoid a smuggling raid, leaving it to drift.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Later, Coast Guard records revealed the Deering had been boarded by Navy officials under secret orders.

end.line: What really happened to the Deering, and who ordered its abandonment?

description: Explore the baffling abandonment of the Carroll A. Deering and the lingering questions.
